shortDescription: Manage virtual machines on NetActuate infrastructure.

options.name: auth_token
options.description: API Key which should be set in ENV variable HOSTVIRTUAL_API_KEY C(auth_token) is required.

options.name: hostname
options.description: Hostname of the node. C(name) can only be a valid hostname. Either C(name) is required.

options.name: location
options.description: Name or id of physical location the node should be built in. Required. Note, Currently once this is set it cannot be changed from ansible.

options.name: mbpkgid
options.description: The purchased package ID the node is associated with. Required as purchasing new nodes is not yet available here.

options.name: name
options.description: Custom display name of the instances. Host name will be set to C(name) if not specified. Either C(name) or C(hostname) is required.

options.name: operating_system
options.description: Either the ID or full name of the OS to be installed on the node. C(operating_system) is required. NOTE, to many choices to list here. Will provide a script for customers to list OSes.

options.name: ssh_public_key
options.description: Path to the ssh key that will be used for node authentication. C(ssh_public_key) is required for host authentication setup.
